item.title: Vitamin D linked to improved cognitive scores in older adults
item.description: Older adults with mild cognitive impairment and sleep issues who took at least 5,000 IU of vitamin D daily scored over 13% higher on cognitive tests.

item.title: Experimental compound burns fat without losing muscle
item.description: A compound studied for decades may offer a new obesity treatment by increasing energy expenditure rather than suppressing appetite. In mice, it showed promise.

item.title: Physicists create a tiny 'Big Bang' with unexpectedly small atomic nuclei
item.description: CERN researchers have produced miniature versions of the early Universe by colliding very small atomic nuclei at nearly light speed.
